about_the_game:
The Zamazingo is a dark, atmospheric, puzzle-filled indie adventure platformer set in a mysterious black-and-white world.

Trees and flowers stand in silence, shadows stretch across the land, and strange secrets hide all around. Try to survive in this limbo. Where are you? Are you lost? Can you solve the puzzles and escape?

Recover the lost time… escape the darkness! The last thing I remember was an old TV. Only two colours exist here — black and white. This is a world without light, a place where I long for Carolina. If only I hadn’t gone…

Story: An airship was carrying a time machine when it suddenly fell and crashed into a small village. Curious Mark went to investigate — but it was the wrong decision. An ancient, TV-shaped time machine pulled him into the Zamazingo limbo — a dim, swirling dimension outside of time. Now, trapped in a gothic, strange, and frightening world, Mark must find the lost limbo time machine to return home. Avoid deadly traps, escape spinning saws, and survive the horrors of this black-and-white land.

Features:

Atmospheric, artistic silhouette graphics and immersive sound design

Hidden traps, mystic forests, deep caves, and puzzling mine shafts

Physics-based gameplay with mysterious inhabitants

Light beams piercing the dark sky and moody landscapes

Unique puzzle-platformer levels to explore
